text:
sara.h: Heads up — we started seeing a spike of 502 / TLS handshake failures across eu-west after last night's cert rotation. Proxy layer shows old chain being served by some edges. KMS audit shows Unwrap denies for cert-provisioner SA. Anyone else seeing this?

mike_r: Which proxy clusters? I can pull logs.

sara.h: Mostly proxy-eu-* and some repl-egress nodes. Error window ~09:10-09:25 UTC.

lucy: I rolled a tight RBAC tweak on KMS for cert-provisioner earlier to remove broad decrypt scope in eu-west (PR #4321). Could be related.

ranjit: If cert-provisioner can't unwrap a new intermediate, it won't push the chain update and proxies may keep serving stale cached certs until eviction. Check KMS audit + keystore write traces.

mike_r: grabbing logs now. snippet:```
2026-03-21T09:12:04Z proxy-eu-01 ERROR handshake: certchain mismatch: missing intermediate
2026-03-21T09:12:05Z kms-unwrap ERROR AccessDenied: caller=svc:cert-provisioner@redwood project=eu-west region=eu-west1
2026-03-21T09:12:07Z cert-provisioner WARN push-failed keystore_write=403
```

sara.h: also seeing OCSP stapling 504s around same time. maybe stapling responder timed out and cache fallback logic hit.

lucy: yup that RBAC change removed kms:Decrypt on the regional key binding. It was a scoped hardening but we missed the cert-provisioner exception. My bad.

mike_r: can we revert just the decrypt permission for svc:cert-provisioner in eu-west quickly?

devops-bot: iam-bot: Rollback request queued by mike_r — applying minimal role binding revert in eu-west. change-id=cbx-20260321-01

mike_r: reverted. monitoring.

devops-bot: iam-bot: Role binding revert applied (change-id=cbx-20260321-01) — svc:cert-provisioner granted kms:Decrypt on key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/cert-key

mike_r: after revert: handshake errors down ~55% in first 5m, OCSP 504s reduced. still watching TTL edge cases.

ranjit: action items: add an automated correlation alert for KMS Unwrap AccessDenied events scoped to svc:cert-provisioner and cert rotation windows; add a policy that RBAC tighten PRs must include a cert-provisioner smoke test in each region.

lucy: will open follow-up PR: reduce proxy cert cache TTL to 5m during rotation windows, add OCSP stapling healthcheck, and document required kms:Decrypt binding for cert-provisioner regional keys. PR -> ENG-OPS backlog.

sara.h: also file change for audit retention: keep KMS Unwrap and keystore writes for 90 days for compliance traces.

mike_r: added a short runbook note to the rotation playbook: if cert-provisioner unwrap fails, revert minimal decrypt binding and force keystore push, then evict proxy caches.

ranjit: good. after follow-ups, let's do a scoped dry-run in eu-west-staging before prod rotation.

sara.h: thanks all. tagging @oncall for visibility and I'll update incident log. :thumbsup:
